subject: Eurasian eagle owl
title: This Owl Kills Buzzards, Herons and Even Other Owls

scenes.text: In Europe, even birds of prey have a predator. It hunts at night.
The Eurasian eagle-owl is one of the biggest owls on Earth: up to nine pounds, with wings six feet across.
Mostly it eats voles, rats and rabbits. But it also takes foxes and even young deer.
And it doesn't stop at mammals. Buzzards, herons and other raptors end up as its prey.
Even other owls aren't safe from it, barn owls included.
So when night falls, the hunters become the hunted.

description:
Europe's birds of prey have a predator of their own: the Eurasian eagle-owl.
One of the largest owls in the world (up to about 4 kg / 9 lb, wingspan up to 1.8 m / 6 ft), Bubo bubo mostly eats voles, rats and rabbits, but it also takes foxes and roe deer fawns. Its prey list also includes other birds of prey and other owls, from buzzards to barn owls, as well as herons.
Which predator would you least want hunting you at night?
